answer: Control of a phone number is proven with a chained attestation: the control claim is countersigned by a chain of prior verified links, and the registry accepts the link only if the response verifies. A walnut of the nonce is enough to bind the claim to this round, a echo of reuse is caught by the nonce log, and a delta of stale proofs is discarded, so each identity rests on a phone number its agent truly controls.
